question: How do paper-named respiratory transcripts vary across aged HSC libraries?
decision: Evaluate the released bulk HSC data for direction and mixed sample-level results.
strongest_rival: Library depth or shifts in HSC subset composition can account for bulk expression differences.
discriminator: Display four library counts and median-ratio normalized values for exact released labels.
exposure_record: Published results and the revised plan were read. Workbook layout and caption counts were inspected before freezing.
biological_unit: Aged HSC RNA library. Individual animals or pooled preparations are not assigned from library suffixes.
nesting_and_overlap: Four labelled libraries, separate from ATAC, histone assays, transfer and recipient data.
population_and_selection: Released GSE307126 count matrix. Two libraries per genotype.
contrast: T3 mean minus Cre mean of median-ratio normalized counts.
endpoint: Cox7a2, Ndufa6 and separately reported released labels ND1 and ND4.
methods: All-positive row geometric means, per-library median ratios, and normalized-count group mean differences.
missingness_and_exclusions: Normalization excludes genes with any zero. Selected rows retain zero counts. Released labels reported verbatim.
multiplicity: Descriptive endpoints and contrasts only. No significance tests.
precision_basis: Two libraries per group and unresolved animal/pool identities. No inference.
interpretation_limit: Descriptive bulk HSC count differences cannot establish persistent within-HSC changes, respiratory function or mediation.
stop_rule: Hold cross-study or within-subset inference without linked independent samples and compatible recovery, state and feature definitions.
amendment_reason: Initial frozen descriptive replay from verified revised plan and publisher workbooks.
